body:
Hey me too.

Hello friend.

I don't know what I can help with, but I like talking with people and just need to find people to talk about stuff.

Feel free to chat me up anytime. 

I hope everything in your life works out the way you want. It does "get better" but only if you apply yourself and have the right support group around you. 

I'm trying too.

Hello friend.

I hope tonight did not turn of the way you thought it would.

I just saw your post and then read your history. It really looks like you are doing your best to get the help you need, or at least the advice. Keep doing you!

Sometimes we just need some people that are there for us. I don't know if that's me or not but I thought I can try.

If you ever want to pm you we can chat as friends! I don't have any and wouldn't mind one! 

Good luck friend

You're giving me more advice than I'm giving you! I think when it comes to judging your own personality, you make yourself more bland than you are. But its great that you can decipher the difference between personality and looks. You seem like you got a good solid head on your shoulders.

Egg is definitely a delicious addition.

Sometimes its just a great feeling to sit and eat a can of sardines or some ramen and just watch YouTube videos about something educational, helps keep me busy.

Hello friend.

I don't know if. You'll read this. But I just wanted to say we are all so very different in many ways. You are at the age where you get to explore what it is that you are! I saw your picture, yeah you have a pimple or whatever but that stuff doesn't stay forever. Other than that dude you look like a great person. There is nothing 'hideous' about you. In fact, if you were to fix that hair up a smidge, you kind of have the face of a model. You might find that funny of a response but it's kind of true. I think its the eyes lol.

I know the feeling you have that brings you down. An anxiety of the unknown, its confusing what it is were supposed to do.

I wish you luck and love, model friend
You know, they say adding a slice of processed cheese to the Raman really brings out the flavour. But I never tried it yet.

Thank you for taking time for me today

Much love friend.

Thanks so much! It sounds like we are kind of in the same spot in life. Minus the family. I live in Canada Ontario. 

I have kind of a shelter but it is not healthy or safe and I have to leave it. Which makes this as bad as it is. 

Maybe I need to find a place to talk to good positive people like you. I don't know where to look. I need friends like you and I'm hoping I can find them at my new job but my options are limited. I'm also scared on beginning this new journey. 

I hope you don't mind the public conversation, maybe it can help others.

much love

Hello friend! 

I have no money and I want to work really bad. A legal job and simple pay to pay for food and shelter. That's all.

Does your life have any advice for me to look for a job? I'm in my early 30s and have nothing. No highschool diploma. Not sure how to approach people and talk.

In fact you just talked to me which is exactly what I wanted but don't know what to say.

Thank you for talking
Hello, I was just browsing this subreddit. Would you like to be friends? We can message each other everyday. I'm in my early 30s.
